text:
maria_cs: @alex_g @jess_security quick escalation — FinNova submitted a bespoke SIG (not the standard CAIQ) and wants KMS/HSM evidence + audit log exports. They also reported intermittent 401s on our hosted API and a billing spike during the same window. Due: Fri EOD PT. I'm attaching the repro logs below.

alex_g: on it. can you paste the exact 401 log lines and request-ids?

maria_cs: pasted from their case FV-992:
```
2024-11-03T18:11:54Z request_id=req_01HXYZ auth_error=missing-jwt path=/v1/generate status=401 tenant=finnova-prod
2024-11-03T18:11:57Z request_id=req_01HXY2 backend_error=hsm-timeout path=/kms/unwrap status=503
2024-11-03T18:12:03Z request_id=req_01HXY5 auth_error=invalid-token path=/v1/embeddings status=401 tenant=finnova-prod
2024-11-03T18:12:20Z request_id=req_01HXY9 billing_event=burst_retries cost_usd=12.40 tenant=finnova-prod
```

They say tokens were valid on client side. Reports started ~2024-11-03 18:11 UTC and lasted ~10m. Also they want confirmation audit logs are retained for 365 days for Dedicated tenants and an HSM vendor cert.

sam_sre: quick PCR: I see our KMS rotation job logged transient HSM timeouts at 18:11:57 and 18:12:02 followed by retries. Repro I ran locally:
```
TOKEN=eyJhbGci...sample
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'
# expected 200, got 401 with header x-request-id=req_01HXY5
```

Root cause (prelim): rotation retries briefly caused unwrap failures which bubbled up as 401s for in-flight tokens. The retry/backoff behavior for the rotation job has been hardened in the hotfix I just pushed (backoff + jitter). No keys were compromised.

jess_security: For the bespoke SIG: we can provide the CAIQ mappings for key management and audit controls. I will prepare:
- HSM vendor attestation and FIPS cert snippet (redact non-customer fields)
- Audit log export (redacted) covering 2024-11-03 00:00–23:59 UTC
- Statement on retention: Dedicated tenants = 365 days default, can extend on Private.

I need confirmation of the exact fields FinNova wants filled on the bespoke template — can you forward the bespoke form pages?

maria_cs: they sent 6 pages, highlighted KMS sections and an "evidence" column they want inline. Deadline Fri 17:00 PST. I'll send the initial response with logs + repro + pledge for full SI G docs by Tue next week.

alex_g: attaching an audit-export snippet for the window and the rotation job logs we collected:
```
{"ts":"2024-11-03T18:11:57Z","event":"kms.unwrap.failure","request_id":"req_01HXY2","details":"hsm timeout"}
{"ts":"2024-11-03T18:12:00Z","event":"kms.unwrap.retry","request_id":"req_01HXY2","attempt":2}
```

Confirmed: Dedicated tenants maintain 365-day audit logs. The billing spike maps to retries and increased token exchange attempts — will need finance/billing breakdown to reconcile customer invoice. Hotfix deployed to rotation flow; monitoring alert added. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Incident created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2024-1123 by alex_g at 2024-11-03T18:20Z

maria_cs: thanks team. I'll send the quick triage to FinNova now with attached repro, incident link, and ETA for full CAIQ/bespoke responses. @sam_sre can you open a ticket to map the billing spike to retries and estimate credits?

sam_sre: created BL-3456 to map cost spike + will attach per-request token counts and retry histogram.

maria_cs: perfect — I'll CC security and legal on the response.
